'''2020 MPC Sean Mackin LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Sean Mackin]] at [[2020 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

* '''Player:''' [[Sean Mackin]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Match Play Championship]]

* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
